newsitem.title: USA: Manhattan Bagel sees turnaround in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Manhattan Bagel sees turnaround in 1998.

text.p: Manhattan Bagel Co Inc said Monday it expects a "significant turnaround in 1998."
"With the losses during the second half of 1996 behind us, 1997 is shaping up as a transition period for Manhattan Bagel," said Chairman and Chief Executive Jack Grumet.
"We're continuing to work to put our house in order as we move to position the company for what is expected to be a significant turnaround in 1998."
The company today reported second quarter earnings of $86,000, or $0.01 per share, down from $175,000, or $0.02 per share, including a $110,000 tax benefit, a year ago.
